- Olives: 49 ml × 0.6 ≈ 30 g. Counting gives 13 olives at about 4–5 g each ≈ 55 g, so I take about 50 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Tomatoes: 70 g × 18 kcal/100 g ≈ 13 kcal
- Olives: 50 g × 230 kcal/100 g ≈ 115 kcal (Kalamata olives in brine/oil run roughly 200–250 kcal/100 g)

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 120 g and roughly 128 kcal. That is plausible for a small snack of tomatoes and olives.
